claims.claim_text: The indexed Morris Berg is strongly matched to Morris “Moe” Berg, whom the CIA biography identifies as an OSS veteran.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official index supplies the exact uncommon name and Box 51 pointer; the CIA independently supplies the full name, nickname, and OSS service.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Exact uncommon full name plus an authoritative institutional account of OSS service.
claims.temporal_assessment: The CIA biography gives a sequential 1942 retirement, federal assignment, and 1943 OSS recruitment chronology.
claims.match_notes: High confidence rather than confirmed because the indexed personnel file has not been reviewed.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Lieutenant Commander Richard M. Helms is strongly matched to Richard Helms, whom the CIA history documents as a commissioned Navy officer transferred to OSS.

claims.temporal_assessment: The CIA history dates Navy entry to 1942 and transfer to OSS to 1943.
